title: KDE KCM flow failures and residual risks

residual_risks.runtime_dbus_untested: C++ D-Bus calls and signal forwarding compile and link, but runtime behavior against a live system-bus daemon is not exercised in CI (no system-bus daemon in CI environment). The abi-smoke test verifies the C ABI only. Runtime verification requires the daemon running on the system bus (human-gated per AGENTS.md).
residual_risks.qml_visual_qa: QML compiles via AOT (qmlcache) without warnings, but visual rendering and interactive behavior are not exercised in CI. Requires a Plasma 6 session with the KCM installed (human-gated).
residual_risks.polkit_pam_toggle: setPamServiceEnabled is polkit-gated on the daemon side (org.namtor.configure-pam). The KCM only requests it; the polkit prompt appears at runtime. Not exercisable in CI.
residual_risks.clang_lsp_qt6_headers: clang LSP reports false-positive 'file not found' for Qt6 headers (QAbstractListModel, QString) because the LSP config lacks Qt6 include paths. These are NOT compilation errors — cmake build succeeds. Pre-existing LSP config limitation, unrelated to this task.
residual_risks.qml_lsp_not_configured: No QML LSP server configured (.qml extension). QML correctness verified via cmake AOT compile + qmlcache, not LSP.

must_not_do_violations: none — no changes to namtor-daemon, namtor-gnome, namtor-pam-config, namtor-store, namtor-layout, or packaging files
